title: RAG
source: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) exam guide · Domain 3
hint: Place it in the retrieval path: preparing knowledge, finding candidates, improving their relevance, or ensuring the generated answer remains supported and traceable.

items.label: Indicates whether the retrieval stage finds the evidence needed to answer a question.
items.why: If 100 questions require a known evidence passage and the retriever returns it for 85, retrieval recall is 85%. Low retrieval recall points to chunking, embeddings, filters, query rewriting, or candidate-count problems that generation cannot repair.
